ترتضخي (form VIII)
# تَرْتَضِخِي (tartaḍiḵī) /tar.ta.dˤi.xiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِرْتَضَخَ (irtaḍaḵa)
# تُرْتَضَخِي (turtaḍaḵī) /tur.ta.dˤa.xiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِرْتَضَخَ (irtaḍaḵa)
